---
title: "Part 1 — Foundations"
---

Part 1 is **Module 1 — Understand a Pico** in the capsule-first course
spine proposed in [`memo23.md`](../../../memo23.md) §4. It introduces
the vocabulary and mental model for Picos and is designed to be
completed before Parts 2 and 3.

## Lessons

- [1. Understand a Pico](01-introduction/index.qmd) — what a Pico is,
  the four terms *capability*, *capsule definition*, *capsule
  implementation*, and *composed Pico*, and how the pieces fit together.

Each lesson in this course follows the same page layout — see the
[course overview](../index.qmd) for the full pattern.
